skips.detail: Web agent text is HTML-escaped at store time (formatOutbound, deliberate); renderSvgFences runs before entity decoding, so agent-authored svg fences never reach the sanitiser and the source fallback shows literal <svg. User-authored fences render (see @ux-original-029).

After a failed Steer the warning shows but the item stays hidden until reload; /agent/queue-state still lists it and it is delivered after the turn. Failed 6/6 projects in one run, 4/6 in the rc.11 full run.

The drafting agent_status ('Writing response...') arrives over SSE but is sometimes not rendered; Draft/Thoughts panes are, and a reload shows the status. Timing-dependent: WebKit desktop 3/6 to 5/6 runs; also seen once on Chromium tablet with four suites loading the host.

After a rejected Return, Cancel or Steer the failure shows but the item stays hidden until reload while /agent/queue-state still lists it (Return then risks a duplicate send). Same cause as @ux-original-030; the Steer path does not fail on every run.
Escape from a focused menu item closes the workspace menu but leaves focus on document.body (all six projects); pointer dismissal passes.

Fenced code 'a < b && c > d' renders and copies as 'a <b> d' in user and agent posts (restoreAllowedHtmlTags turns it into a <b> tag; piclaw#1511). Copy message on agent posts copies HTML-escaped stored text ('a < b'; piclaw#1505).
Already-prevented and repeated keydowns on timeline content open Quick actions (no defaultPrevented/repeat check); whitespace, composing and modified keys are ignored correctly. All six projects.

Reload and Overwrite work; Save copy always fails with 'Save copy failed: File not found' (onSaveCopy updates a file that does not exist) and writes no copy.
Save completion ignores edits typed while the write was pending: Chromium keeps the text but marks the tab clean; WebKit reverts the editor to the saved text.
At phone width a clean editor tab keeps the old text after the file changes elsewhere (no refresh, no notice); tablet and desktop widths refresh it.
